provenance.study: Miller, George A. and Patricia E. Nicely. 1955. An Analysis of Perceptual Confusions Among Some English Consonants. Journal of the Acoustical Society of America 27:338-352. DOI: 10.1121/1.1907526. Six flat-noise conditions, S/N -18, -12, -6, 0, +6, and +12 dB over 200-6500 cps; five female talkers/listeners; sixteen consonants before /a/; approximately 4000 observations per original directional matrix. These values are the aggregate across those conditions, converted to symmetric pairwise misclassification probabilities.
provenance.transcription: Phipps Arabie and J. Douglas Carroll, mapclus.data, SECOND MDS Package of AT&T Bell Laboratories, distributed by Netlib in mds/mapclus.shar. The lower-triangle values were transcribed byte-faithfully from its MILLER-NICELY section (Fortran format 15F5.3); this file mirrors them across the diagonal and maps its labels PA TA KA FA THETA SA SHA BA DA GA VA THAT ZA ZHA MA NA to house IPA p t k f θ s ʃ b d ɡ v ð z ʒ m n.
